Definition: a head person (of any rank or class)
BiblicalUsage: 1) prince, ruler, leader, chief, chieftain, official, captain; 1a) chieftain, leader; 1b) vassal, noble, official (under king); 1c) captain, general, commander (military); 1d) chief, head, overseer (of other official classes); 1e) heads, princes (of religious office); 1f) elders (of representative leaders of people); 1g) merchant-princes (of rank and dignity); 1h) patron-angel; 1i) Ruler of rulers (of God); 1j) warden
